tool_input.command:
mkdir -p forgemyspec-bundle/task-manager && cat > forgemyspec-board.yaml <<'EOF'
- id: R1
  status: doing
  title: "CLI Task Manager (task_manager.py)"
  quote: "Build a CLI Task Manager in Python. Add, list, update, delete tasks (CRUD)... SQLite raw sqlite3... filter by status and priority... mark done... formatted table... single file task_manager.py... stdlib only."
  steps:
    - {do: "Write spec.yaml and lint it", check: "cmd: PYTHONPATH=.forgemyspec/harness python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/task-manager/spec.yaml --formal"}
    - {do: "User approves the spec bundle (approve code typed in chat)", ok: false}

cat > forgemyspec-bundle/task-manager/spec.yaml <<'EOF'
version: "0.1"
title: "CLI Task Manager"
objective: "A single-file, stdlib-only Python CLI (task_manager.py) that manages tasks with CRUD, filtering, mark-done and table output, persisted in SQLite through raw sqlite3."
execution_mode: critical
context:
  system: "Empty Python repository; ForgeMySpec strict mode. Deliverable is task_manager.py at the repository root plus unittest tests under tests/."
  assumptions:
    - "The database path defaults to tasks.db in the current directory and can be overridden with --db or the TASK_DB environment variable."
    - "due_date is optional and uses ISO format YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates are rejected."
    - "Default priority is medium and default status is todo when not given."
    - "Subcommands are add, list, update, delete, done, with argparse."
    - "Title is required and non-empty; description is optional."
    - "Python 3.8+ stdlib only."
constraints:
  - "No external dependencies beyond the Python standard library."
  - "No ORM; only the raw sqlite3 module with parameterized queries."
  - "Everything lives in the single file task_manager.py; no other module is imported from the project."
  - "No web UI, no authentication, no multi-user features, no recurring tasks, no tags or subtasks."
  - "Output is plain text; no colors or third-party table libraries."
success_criteria:
  - "add, list, update, delete and done all work end to end against a SQLite file."
  - "list --status and --priority filter correctly, alone and combined."
  - "Invalid priority, status, date or unknown id exits non-zero with a message on stderr."
  - "Tasks survive across separate invocations."
hypotheses:
  - {id: h1, description: "add creates a task with id, title, description, priority, status and due_date and persists it in SQLite", confidence: 0.95}
  - {id: h2, description: "update changes only the given fields of an existing task, and delete removes it", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h3, description: "list filters tasks by status and by priority, alone or combined", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h4, description: "done marks a task as status done", confidence: 0.95}
  - {id: h5, description: "list prints tasks as a formatted table with a header row and aligned columns", confidence: 0.85}
  - {id: h6, description: "invalid priority, status, date or unknown task id is rejected with a non-zero exit code and an error message", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h7, description: "the implementation is one file task_manager.py using only stdlib and raw sqlite3", confidence: 0.95}
required_evidence:
  - "unittest run output showing all boundary tests in tests/ pass"
  - "gate report ending with RESULT: PASS"
  - "sample session output of add, list, update, done and delete against a temporary database"
actions:
  - {id: a1, description: "Design the schema and argparse subcommands", type: design, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4]}
  - {id: a2, description: "Implement task_manager.py with sqlite3 persistence and CRUD", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h4, h7]}
  - {id: a3, description: "Implement list filters and the table formatter", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h3, h5]}
  - {id: a4, description: "Implement input validation and error exits", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h6]}
  - {id: a5, description: "Write unittest boundary tests and run the gate", type: validate, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]}
decision_rules:
  - "If a requirement needs a non-stdlib module, stop and ask the user."
  - "If behavior is not covered by an obligation, propose a spec amendment instead of adding it."
  - "Stop and report if any test fails; do not weaken tests to pass."
metadata:
  source_prompt: "Build a CLI Task Manager in Python. Requirements: Add, list, update, delete tasks (CRUD). Each task has: id, title, description, priority (low/medium/high), status (todo/in-progress/done), due_date. Persist data in SQLite (no ORM, raw sqlite3). Filter tasks by status and priority. Mark task as done. Output as formatted table in terminal. Single file CLI entry point: task_manager.py. No external dependencies beyond stdlib."
  generator: claude-code-session
  scope_contract:
    must_include:
      - "add, list, update, delete tasks"
      - "task fields id, title, description, priority, status, due_date"
      - "priority low/medium/high"
      - "status todo/in-progress/done"
      - "persist in SQLite with raw sqlite3"
      - "filter by status and priority"
      - "mark task as done"
      - "formatted table output"
      - "single file task_manager.py"
      - "no external dependencies beyond stdlib"
formal:
  module: TaskManager
  obligations:
    - id: add_and_persist
      kind: boundary
      statement: "add stores a task with id, title, description, priority, status and due_date; it is readable by a later separate invocation."
      hypotheses: [h1]
      must_include: ["add, list, update, delete tasks", "task fields id, title, description, priority, status, due_date", "persist in SQLite with raw sqlite3"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_add_persists_across_invocations"
    - id: allowed_values
      kind: boundary
      statement: "priority accepts only low, medium, high and status only todo, in-progress, done; defaults are medium and todo; other values exit non-zero."
      hypotheses: [h1, h6]
      must_include: ["priority low/medium/high", "status todo/in-progress/done"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_invalid_priority_and_status_rejected"
    - id: update_and_delete
      kind: boundary
      statement: "update changes only the given fields and delete removes the task; an unknown id exits non-zero."
      hypotheses: [h2, h6]
      must_include: ["add, list, update, delete tasks"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_update_and_delete"
    - id: filter_list
      kind: boundary
      statement: "list --status and --priority return only matching tasks, alone and combined."
      hypotheses: [h3]
      must_include: ["filter by status and priority"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_list_filters"
    - id: mark_done
      kind: boundary
      statement: "done ID sets status to done and leaves other fields unchanged."
      hypotheses: [h4]
      must_include: ["mark task as done"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_done_marks_task"
    - id: table_output
      kind: boundary
      statement: "list prints a header row and one aligned row per task with the columns ID, Title, Priority, Status, Due."
      hypotheses: [h5]
      must_include: ["formatted table output"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_list_prints_table"
    - id: invalid_input
      kind: boundary
      statement: "invalid due_date, empty title or unknown id exit non-zero with a message on stderr."
      hypotheses: [h6]
      must_include: ["task fields id, title, description, priority, status, due_date"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_invalid_input_exits_nonzero"
    - id: single_file_stdlib
      kind: boundary
      statement: "task_manager.py imports only stdlib modules and is the single entry point, with no ORM."
      hypotheses: [h7]
      must_include: ["single file task_manager.py", "no external dependencies beyond stdlib"]
      test: "test_task_manager.TaskManagerTests.test_only_stdlib_imports"
scope:
  paths: ["task_manager.py", "tests/**"]
  tests: tests
  pythonpath: ["."]
EOF
export PYTHONPATH=.forgemyspec/harness
python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/task-manager/spec.yaml --formal && python3 -m forgemyspec package forgemyspec-bundle/task-manager/spec.yaml

result:
Spec written, linted (100/100) and packaged at `forgemyspec-bundle/task-manager/`. I haven't written any code yet because the bundle needs your approval first.

**What you're approving:** a spec-only bundle with 7 boundary obligations, all tested with unittest and none proven in Dafny:
- **Add and persist:** `add` stores id, title, description, priority, status and due_date in SQLite via raw `sqlite3`, and the task is readable by a later invocation.
- **Allowed values:** priority is low/medium/high and status is todo/in-progress/done, defaulting to medium and todo. Other values exit non-zero.
- **Update and delete:** `update` changes only the fields you give, `delete` removes the task, and an unknown id exits non-zero.
- **Filtering:** `list --status` and `--priority` filter alone or combined.
- **Mark done:** `done ID` sets the status to done and leaves other fields alone.
- **Table output:** `list` prints a header row and aligned rows with columns ID, Title, Priority, Status, Due.
- **Invalid input:** a bad due date, an empty title or an unknown id exits non-zero with a message on stderr.
- **Single file, stdlib only:** `task_manager.py` imports only stdlib modules, with no ORM.

**Assumptions I made:**
- The database defaults to `tasks.db` in the current directory, overridable with `--db` or `TASK_DB`.
- `due_date` is optional and must be `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- Subcommands are `add`, `list`, `update`, `delete` and `done`, built with argparse.
- Title is required; description is optional.

**Scope:** `scope.paths` covers only `task_manager.py` and `tests/**`.
